verdict.rationale: Elicit has a public pricing page that lists plan features and some usage limits, such as unlimited search and unlimited chat with papers. The docs also note which plan tiers (Pro, Scale, Enterprise) unlock table exports and API access, and that the library has no PDF limit. However, the evidence never shows actual plan prices or any per-plan quotas beyond those unlimited claims. Missing for 10: actual dollar prices per plan, a per-tier comparison of usage quotas/credits, independent corroboration of pricing clarity.

support.subject: As a researcher, I can understand plan pricing and usage limits before committing

citations.quote: Unlimited search across more than 138 million papers
Unlimited chat with papers with full-text access
Pro, Scale, and Enterprise subscribers can export tables from Systematic Reviews, including the screening recommendation tables and the data extraction table.
Research Reports can be exported as a PDF or Word file, regardless of which Elicit plan you subscribe to.
There is no limit on the number of PDFs your library can hold at this time.
API access requires a Pro plan or above.
